label: LangGraph
description: LangGraph agent with the selected model backend
gettingStarted:
The generated LangGraph agent runs in-process inside the Next.js `/api/chat` route, with your OpenAI-compatible provider as its model. `{{packageManager}} run dev` starts the app. Share a preview with `npx @openuidev/cli@latest deploy`.
Ask "What's the weather in Berlin?" to exercise its native tool loop.
